definitions.explanation: Indicating the upper limit of what can be expected; no more than.

definitions.gloss: as much as possible, to the best of one's ability
definitions.explanation: Doing something with maximum effort (often with slight resignation or irony).

examples.japanese: {精々|せいぜい}100⟦{人|にん}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精々|せいぜい}⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is about all I can do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{精々|せいぜい}⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: With my current salary, I can eat out at most about once a month.

examples.english: Do your best (as much as you can).
examples.notes: Can sound slightly dismissive depending on context

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧、{精々|せいぜい}⟦{楽|たの}しんで→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦こい→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: If you have time, enjoy yourself as much as you can.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}り→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦なんだ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{精々|せいぜい}⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦おいた→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You don't have much vacation left, so you'd better rest as much as you can while you have the chance.

notes:
{精々|せいぜい} is an adverb with two main nuances: setting an upper limit ("at most") and doing one's best (sometimes with an ironic edge).

MEANING 1 - UPPER LIMIT:
Sets a ceiling, implying the actual amount is less than expected.
- {精々|せいぜい}100⟦{人|にん}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧: at most about 100 people
- {精々|せいぜい}3⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧: at most 3 days

MEANING 2 - ENCOURAGEMENT/IRONY:
When used to mean "do your best," it often carries a slightly dismissive or ironic tone, depending on context.
- {精々|せいぜい}⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: good luck with that / do your best (can sound sarcastic)

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana (せいぜい). The kanji {精々|せいぜい} is uncommon.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精々|せいぜい}: at most (upper limit)
- ⟦{少|すく}なくとも→少なくとも：03364_sukunakutomo⟧: at least (lower limit)
- ⟦せめて→せめて：10344_semete⟧: at least (expresses a wish for a minimum)
